parameters.query:
SELECT a.id as ad_id, a.name as ad_name, c.id as ca_id, c.name as cam_name
FROM advertisement a
JOIN advertisement_group ag ON ag.id = a."advertisementGroupId"
JOIN campaign c ON ag."campaignId" = c.id
WHERE c."advertiserId" IN (4653)

=SELECT
      day,
      campaign_id,
      ads_id                                                       AS advertisement_id,
      sum(v_views)                                                 AS views,
      sum(v_clicks)                                                AS clicks,
      sum(v_spend)                                                 AS spending,
      CASE WHEN sum(v_views) > 0
           THEN round(sum(v_spend) * 1000 / sum(v_views), 5)
           ELSE NULL END                                           AS cpm,
      CASE WHEN sum(v_clicks) > 0
           THEN round(sum(v_spend) / sum(v_clicks), 5)
           ELSE NULL END                                           AS cpc,
      CASE WHEN sum(v_views) > 0
           THEN round(sum(v_clicks) / sum(v_views) * 100, 5)
           ELSE NULL END                                           AS ctr
  FROM (
      SELECT
          day,
          campaign_id,
          ads_id,
          total_views            AS v_views,
          0                      AS v_clicks,
          advertiser_spend_sum   AS v_spend
      FROM analytics.mv_impression_daily
      WHERE ads_id IN ({{ $("info").all().map(a=>a.json.ad_id) }})
        AND day >= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.startDay }}')
        AND day <= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.maxDay }}')
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
          day,
          campaign_id,
          ads_id,
          0             AS v_views,
          total_clicks  AS v_clicks,
          0             AS v_spend
      FROM analytics.mv_click_daily
      WHERE ads_id IN ({{ $("info").all().map(a=>a.json.ad_id) }})
        AND day >= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.startDay }}')
        AND day <= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.maxDay }}')
  )
  GROUP BY day, campaign_id, ads_id
  ORDER BY day DESC, campaign_id, ads_id;

=SELECT
      campaign_id,
      ads_id         AS advertisement_id,
      sum(v_views)   AS views,
      sum(v_clicks)  AS clicks
  FROM (
      SELECT
          campaign_id,
          ads_id,
          total_views   AS v_views,
          0             AS v_clicks
      FROM analytics.mv_impression_daily
      WHERE ads_id IN ({{ $("info").all().map(a=>a.json.ad_id) }})
        AND day <= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.maxDay }}')
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
          campaign_id,
          ads_id,
          0             AS v_views,
          total_clicks  AS v_clicks
      FROM analytics.mv_click_daily
      WHERE ads_id IN ({{ $("info").all().map(a=>a.json.ad_id) }})
        AND day <= toDate('{{ $("config").first().json.maxDay }}')
  )
  GROUP BY campaign_id, ads_id
  ORDER BY campaign_id, ads_id;
